title: Parking an Employee Meal Account for Leave, and Closing It
content:
An Employee Meal Account is parked for recorded leave at the employer's instruction and unparked when the employee returns, and it may stay parked no longer than the leave ceiling printed against the plan before it is closed instead.

## The state the account must stand in

A parking, an unparking or a closure is only worked while the account stands active, parked for leave or closed, and an account still enrolled is cancelled rather than parked. The account's own record settles this before the parking, the unparking or the closure is worked, read by the account's reference together with the stored value and the charges awaiting recovery standing on it.

## Notice

Unparking needs the notice printed against the plan, counted in calendar days, so that allowance can be rebuilt before the employee returns to the counter.

Only the employee may close their own meal account, and the desk records the request for the employee to confirm rather than closing it on their word alone; a closure needs the notice printed against the plan.

## Returning unspent stored value

Unspent stored value is returned no later than the balance return window for the meal plan, counted in calendar days from the day the account is closed. Balance return days are counted as calendar days from the day after closure, every day of the week counts, and a return made on the boundary day itself is in time; calendar days are never converted into full 24-hour periods.

The day the account is closed is taken from the closure recorded on the account itself, not from when the employee says they stopped using the badge.

*Boundary cases, on abstract days.* A return made on the last day of the printed window is in time; a return made on the day after it is not. The day of closure itself is not one of the counted days, counting beginning on the day after, and a weekend day counts like any other.

A balance below the minimum return printed against the plan is not returned, and a plan whose return window is zero holds no stored value to return in the first place.

## Allowance and arrears at closure

Unspent employer allowance is never returned to the employee at closure; it goes back to the employer's funding, since it was never the employee's money.

Charges awaiting payroll recovery are settled before closure, from stored value first and then from final pay, and an account is not closed while arrears stand unrecovered and no final pay is due.
